# Election update: Thursday, November 26 (morning)

## Bottom line
No race was called overnight. The House stands at 432 of 435 races called: D 259, R 173, with 218 needed for a majority ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)). Three races remain: MN-01, in a hand recount, and the Louisiana runoffs on Dec. 12. Every Senate race is called: D 56, R 44, counting seats not up ([Senate table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_Senate_elections)). Governorships are final at D 30, R 20 of 50, counting the 14 states with no race this year, with six flips, all to Democrats ([governor table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_gubernatorial_elections)).

## Called since the last update
- None.

## Legal and federal action
- **Texas:** a Trump-appointed federal judge dismissed the Texas GOP's challenge to the midterm results, Chron reports ([Chron](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxORElXN05QakxRWEdfUlVOWWlINUlHMERaeEZ5dks1YTFPQU8zR01oUTRhSVlTOVVwLXFqanFlbnNiTVJkckJtZzh5cUtlaE1Yc0t1d3g2YWoyLWdJSERSaGxHOUZZY0xiRElPQkJrS3pGUGx2cl8xTGQyM3h4cDZlN2FBamFXQU0?oc=5)).
- **Alaska:** Alaska is the first state to quit the Justice Department's voter-data arrangement and ordered the shared list destroyed, Newsweek reports ([Newsweek](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxQWVY5MFhYaTk0Ykt5QjdyWlZaamxNeHk0SWlqYmdMcUUwempRTTVzZ1huTlA4dXBQcXBxWVF0YVRXZ0dGM0lFMXd0czRMSk5QX2RzTWhPTzYtU2l0Q29INm15WmFubkdZOGJWNUJFa1dSSkV6QVZ0dEZRQ2RZXzdRbmR5VEY2MkZtSFhVN2lZdDgwQkFoaTFBT284UlBfbW1LdXB1V2hIbzdnWFhf?oc=5)).
- **California:** a federal appeals court heard arguments in the administration's voting lawsuit against California, ABC News reports ([ABC News](https://news.google.?oc=5)).
- **Georgia:** a judge paused an order requiring Fulton County to turn over 2020 election records seized by the FBI, CBS News reports ([CBS News](https://news.google.?oc=5)).
- **Ohio:** the Ohio Supreme Court's opinion in State ex rel. Schimmel v. Lucas County Board of Elections, issued Nov. 24, is now on CourtListener ([CourtListener](https://www.courtlistener.com/opinion/11070931/state-ex-rel-schimmel-v-lucas-cty-bd-of-elections/)). CourtListener shows filings in 47 election-related federal dockets since Nov. 23.
